<function name="SetBaseDamage" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the initial damage, unmodified by the current skill level (<page>game.GetSkillLevel</page>). This is usually set automatically by the game when dealing damage.

This function will not modify the real damage that will be dealt (<page>CTakeDamageInfo:GetDamage</page>).

Use this only if you know what you are doing. Otherwise use <page>CTakeDamageInfo:SetDamage</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2020.10.14</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="" type="number">The base damage.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
